Very tasty food!
Dec 2025 • Couples
When we arrived it was quiet and not crowded. However just after our food arrived a huge table of very loud speaking people came in and changed the atmosphere immensely.
It seems like they were arguing with the tour guide about something. 
The food on the other hand was delicious. They had very tasty, fresh paneer made into balls and an orange sauce that was made with cashews and not sure what else. 
Unfortunately when I received the dish it only had two paneer balls. as you can see from the photos there were six pictured. Also the size of the bowls differed a lot. I've included pictures of my actual bowl and one from the menu. The waiter tried to tell me that the pictures were just for reference and that the bowl being pictured was a lot smaller than mine. 
That didn't actually match what I was seeing. At any rate the dish was delicious. When my partner asked for a refill of a very small side dish with some yogurt dipping sauce, we were told we had to make an order for some more, but the yogurt came only in a large size. We found that a bit odd.
The chef did a nice job of preparing my dish that's for sure.
